rationale: Republic of Congo is published on a never-assessed uniform seed vector (2/2/2/1.5/2/1.5/2/1.5, composite 20.3) shared byte-identically by twelve countries at ranks 134-145. This full 40-subdimension assessment replaces the seed with evidence and returns 10.6, a difference of -9.7 points. The band moves from Developing to Critical.

band_change_evidence_test.required: at least 2 independent sources, at least 1 at sourceTier >= 4
